description: React Query useMutation onSettled invalidating a parent array queryKey with the default prefix match also invalidates child observers. Deletion mutation that invalidates the list while a brand-by-id route is still mounted causes the deleted observer to refetch and log a console 404 before unmount.
resolution: Pass exact:true to invalidation, or restructure keys so list and detail share no prefix.

name: RHF primitive-array list field via useWatch+setValue
description: useFieldArray initializes from defaultValues only for arrays of objects, not arrays of primitives. Components iterating string[] in RHF must use useWatch({control,name}) + setValue(name, next, {shouldDirty: true}) instead. Used by brand-voice StringListField and AudienceRuleListField.

Next.js dev web container bakes the validation package compiled output into the image; runtime mounts only the package src tree, not the compiled tree. When the validation barrel gains new public exports, webpack reads the stale compiled file via main field and reports import errors; the form resolver crashes when zodResolver gets an undefined schema.
resolution: pnpm stack:up with the rebuild flag rebuilds the web image with the fresh compiled output baked in. The dist auto-mount pattern is api-only by design. The api iterates with stack:reload-api; the web side needs the rebuild flag whenever a sfx package gains new public exports.

name: active-brand-store-content-check-wrapper
description: F2 content-check page reads useActiveBrandStore with two separate single-field selectors for activeBrandId and clear (apps/web/CLAUDE.md gotcha: object-returning Zustand selectors infinite-rerender). The feature-local useContentCheckListRepository wraps the F1 useDosAndDontsRepository to expose isBrandNotFound as a boolean derived from query error status equal to 404, so the page hook never branches on raw HTTP status per ADR-003. The hook stale-id effect calls clear once isBrandNotFound flips, dropping the dead localStorage id so the next visit lands on the no-active-brand branch.

content: vitest plus Testing Library normalizes whitespace by default. Calling screen.getByText with a multi-line literal (with embedded newline) fails the normalization check. Assert preserved newlines via a function matcher that compares node.textContent against the exact literal. Pair with toHaveClass whitespace-pre-wrap to prove both the DOM content and the CSS preservation. Useful whenever a component renders user-pasted text that must preserve line breaks.
